<?php
function warningTail($severityTail, $messageTail) {
    global $xTail, $countTail;
    ++$countTail;
    echo 'warning:', $countTail, ':', $messageTail, '|';
    $xTail = 3.5;
    if ($countTail === 2) { $xTail = 4.5; }
    return true;
}
function valueTail(int $aTail, int &$bTail = 7, int $cTail = 11) {
    echo 'value-body:', $aTail, ':', $bTail, ':', $cTail, ':', $GLOBALS['xTail'], '|';
    return $cTail;
}
function referenceTail(int &$aTail, int $bTail = 7, int &$cTail = 11) {
    echo 'reference-body:', $aTail, ':', $bTail, ':', $cTail, ':', $GLOBALS['xTail'], '|';
    return $cTail;
}
set_error_handler('warningTail');
$xTail = 2;
$countTail = 0;
valueTail($xTail);
referenceTail($xTail);
valueTail(cTail: $xTail, aTail: $xTail);
referenceTail(cTail: $xTail, aTail: $xTail);
try { valueTail(bTail: $xTail); }
catch (ArgumentCountError $caughtTail) { echo 'value-required:', $xTail, '|'; }
try { referenceTail(cTail: $xTail); }
catch (ArgumentCountError $caughtTail) { echo 'reference-required:', $xTail, '|'; }
try { valueTail(); }
catch (ArgumentCountError $caughtTail) { echo 'value-empty:', $xTail, '|'; }
try { referenceTail(); }
catch (ArgumentCountError $caughtTail) { echo 'reference-empty:', $xTail, '|'; }
purpose: Existing positional trailing integer defaults, named interior optional holes, BYREF default cells and missing required-prefix errors without precision callbacks.

<?php
function warningTail($severityTail, $messageTail) {
    global $xTail, $originalTail;
    echo 'warning:', $messageTail, '|';
    $xTail = 3.5;
    throw $originalTail;
}
function valueTail(int $aTail, int &$bTail = 7, int $cTail = 11) {
    echo 'value-body:', $aTail, ':', $bTail, ':', $cTail, ':', $GLOBALS['xTail'], '|';
    return $cTail;
}
function referenceTail(int &$aTail, int $bTail = 7, int &$cTail = 11) {
    echo 'reference-body:', $aTail, ':', $bTail, ':', $cTail, ':', $GLOBALS['xTail'], '|';
    return $cTail;
}
$originalTail = new Exception('original');
set_error_handler('warningTail');
$aTail = 2;
$destinationTail = 91;
$xTail = 1.5;
try { $destinationTail = valueTail($aTail, $xTail); }
catch (Throwable $caughtTail) {
    echo 'positional-value-caught:', (int)($caughtTail === $originalTail), ':', (int)($caughtTail->getPrevious() === null), ':', $destinationTail, ':', $xTail, '|';
}
$xTail = 1.5;
try { $destinationTail = referenceTail($aTail, $xTail); }
catch (Throwable $caughtTail) {
    echo 'positional-reference-caught:', (int)($caughtTail === $originalTail), ':', (int)($caughtTail->getPrevious() === null), ':', $destinationTail, ':', $xTail, '|';
}
$xTail = 1.5;
try { $destinationTail = valueTail(bTail: $xTail, aTail: $aTail); }
catch (Throwable $caughtTail) {
    echo 'reverse-named-value-caught:', (int)($caughtTail === $originalTail), ':', (int)($caughtTail->getPrevious() === null), ':', $destinationTail, ':', $xTail, '|';
}
$xTail = 1.5;
try { $destinationTail = referenceTail(bTail: $xTail, aTail: $aTail); }
catch (Throwable $caughtTail) {
    echo 'reverse-named-reference-caught:', (int)($caughtTail === $originalTail), ':', (int)($caughtTail->getPrevious() === null), ':', $destinationTail, ':', $xTail, '|';
}
$xTail = 1.5;
try { $destinationTail = valueTail(cTail: $xTail, aTail: $aTail); }
catch (Throwable $caughtTail) {
    echo 'named-hole-value-caught:', (int)($caughtTail === $originalTail), ':', (int)($caughtTail->getPrevious() === null), ':', $destinationTail, ':', $xTail, '|';
}
$xTail = 1.5;
try { $destinationTail = referenceTail(cTail: $xTail, aTail: $aTail); }
catch (Throwable $caughtTail) {
    echo 'named-hole-reference-caught:', (int)($caughtTail === $originalTail), ':', (int)($caughtTail->getPrevious() === null), ':', $destinationTail, ':', $xTail, '|';
}
